summary: This is the same 0.1.69 release bump as round 1, now rebased onto base 9ee7b0b. On the new base the protocol constants have not changed: workspace client 26 supports [25, 26] and control-plane client 5 supports [3, 5]. The manifest, desktop version, Pulumi image pins and the minimum frontend of 0.1.68 still match releases/README.md and the validateRelease.mjs checks. The change adds no executable lines and nothing blocks the release.
